jam.utils.codec.codable module¶

Codable interface.

Codable is a common class for all data types that can be do encoding and decoding directly.

class jam.utils.codec.codable.Codable(codec=None)[source]¶

Bases: Generic[T]

Base class for all codable types.

Can be used in three ways: 1. With a codec: Initialize with codec=some_codec 2. With sequence: Initialize with enc_sequence=lambda: [field1, field2, …] 3. With JSON: Use to_json() and from_json() for JSON serialization

Parameters:

codec (Codec[Any] | None)
